label: Maximum
blurb: Photoshop's Maximum: every pixel takes the brightest value around it, so light areas spread and dark details shrink or vanish. Use it to thicken bright lines, choke a dark matte or build a soft blobby base for a painterly look. Square spreads in a box; Round spreads in a circle (built from eight directions). By brightness keeps each pixel's colour together instead of taking the brightest red, green and blue separately.
